source_title: Catherine Zeta-Jones Told Michael Douglas He Needed to ‘Clean’ His ‘Act Up’ Before Dating Her - People.com
source_excerpt:
The couple first met in 1998 and got married in November 2000
Brianna Bryson/FilmMagic; Gary Gershoff/Getty
Michael Douglas shared on The Graham Norton Show on Oct. 30 that his wife Catherine Zeta-Jones told him to “clean” his “act up” when they started dating
The actor revealed in his memoir, One Helluva Ride , that he ended relationships with five women after she asked for exclusivity
One Helluva Ride is on sale now wherever books are sold
Catherine Zeta-Jones had an ultimatum for Michael Douglas when they first got together.
On the Friday, Oct. 30 episode of The Graham Norton Show , Douglas, 82, recalled how Zeta-Jones, 57, warned him to clean up his act if he wanted their romance to progress.
“When I courted Catherine, she told me, ‘If we are doing this, you need to clean your act up,’ ” he shared. “I was divorced and seeing some other people at the time, so I had to call five women to break things off.”
The Academy Award-winning actor previously opened up about ending the five relationships in his memoir, One Helluva Ride , released Oct. 6.
Following his 1995 separation from his first wife, Diandra Luker , Douglas had been seeing women who lived in different cities. But Zeta-Jones made it clear she wanted an exclusive relationship.
“I told her wait here I have to make five quick calls. ‘Five? You have to make five calls?’ ” he wrote.
Ahead of the book’s release, however, Douglas revealed that Zeta-Jones hadn’t yet read his memoir . The memoir also revisits their 2013 separation and reconciliation the following year, which Douglas described to The Sunday Times as a mutual effort.
“We’re good. We’re in good shape,” he said.
Douglas and Zeta-Jones first met at the Deauville Film Festival in France in 1998 , after he saw her in The Mask of Zorro . He immediately asked his publicist to arrange an introduction.
During their first meeting, the Ant-Man star told his future wife, “You know, I’m going to be the father of your children.”
The pair went on to welcome son Dylan , now 26, in August 2000, before tying the knot at New York City’s Plaza Hotel that November. Their daughter, Carys, now 23, arrived in April 2003.

Last November, Zeta-Jones celebrated their 25th wedding anniversary with a series of throwback photos , including a snapshot from their wedding day and a picture from their first meeting.
“I love you today as I did then. Thank you sweetheart♥️,” the Chicago star captioned the post.
Earlier this month, Douglas told PEOPLE that humor and communication have helped sustain their marriage.
“A good sense of humor doesn’t hurt, number one. And talking things out,” he said, adding that they avoid saying “never” and “always” during arguments and try to consider each other’s perspective.
